examples.label: Frequently asked questions with four collapsible answers
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" size="extra_large" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mb-2">Frequently asked questions <.component component_name="chelekom-collapse" site="Global" id="faq-trial" open={true}> <:trigger>
Do I need a card to start the trial? <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-chevron-down" class="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-60" />

No. The fourteen-day trial starts the moment you create a workspace, and we only ask for payment details when you decide to keep it.

<.component component_name="chelekom-collapse" site="Global" id="faq-seats"> <:trigger>
Can I add or remove seats mid-month? <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-chevron-down" class="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-60" />

Yes. Seats are billed by the day, so adding someone on the twelfth costs you the rest of that month and nothing more.

<.component component_name="chelekom-collapse" site="Global" id="faq-export"> <:trigger>
What happens to my pages if I cancel? <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-chevron-down" class="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-60" />

Your site stays online until the end of the billing period, and you can export every page as HEEx at any point, including after the account closes.

<.component component_name="chelekom-collapse" site="Global" id="faq-support"> <:trigger>
How fast is support? <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-chevron-down" class="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-60" />

Every plan gets an answer inside one business day. Teams on the annual plan reach an engineer directly through a shared channel.

examples.label: Product page detail panels for description, shipping and care
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-collapse" site="Global" id="product-description" open={true}> <:trigger>
Description <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-chevron-down" class="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-60" />

Woven from a single length of merino in a mill outside Biella. Two metres long, brushed on both faces, and heavy enough to stay where you put it.

<.component component_name="chelekom-collapse" site="Global" id="product-shipping"> <:trigger>
Shipping and returns <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-truck" class="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-60" />

Free delivery on orders over $75, two to four working days. Returns are accepted unworn within thirty days and we cover the postage.

<.component component_name="chelekom-collapse" site="Global" id="product-care"> <:trigger>
Care instructions <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-chevron-down" class="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-60" />

Hand wash cold with wool detergent, press the water out rather than wringing, and dry flat away from direct heat.
